reason: git credential fill prints 'password=<value>' to stdout -- never invoke it bare, even for a quick debug check. Capture the whole invocation into a shell variable and only ever reference the variable, never its expansion: TOKEN=$(git credential fill <<< $'protocol=https\nhost=<host>\n' | sed -n 's/^password=//p'); then use "$TOKEN" (e.g. in a curl -H header) without ever printing it. [pack=git, pattern=git-credential-fill-bare-stdout]
